dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, files, scripts, and referenced CLI package align around searching, downloading, creating, evaluating, and organizing agent skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation language is broad, including pre-task search and repo/document learning triggers, but the artifact repeatedly gates download, create, evaluate, analyze, loading, and script execution on user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

dimensions.detail: Installation uses standard Python package managers to install the third-party skillnet-ai package; this is purpose-aligned but users should verify the package source before running it.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: API_KEY, BASE_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN, SKILLNET_MODEL, and GITHUB_MIRROR are disclosed and proportionate to LLM-backed creation/evaluation and GitHub access; the data-flow documentation explains where content is sent.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes created or downloaded skills and relationship reports under the user's skill workspace and describes safe removal to trash only after confirmation; no background persistence or automatic deletion is shown.

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The pre-task search trigger is broad, but the autonomous action is limited to short search queries with no credentials or local files, and higher-impact actions require confirmation.
[SQP-1] expected: Triggers for GitHub URLs, documents, logs, and trajectories match the skill-creation purpose; artifact instructions require informing the user and getting approval before sending content.
[SQP-1] expected: The repo-learning workflow can send repository-derived metadata to an LLM endpoint, but this data flow is disclosed and gated by confirmation in the security/privacy reference.
[SQP-1] expected: The library-cleanup trigger for larger skill collections is broad, but analyze is documented as report-only and any pruning or moves require user confirmation.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help manage skills. Review the skillnet-ai package origin, prefer pipx over global pip, and do not approve create/evaluate/analyze on sensitive repos, documents, or logs unless you are comfortable sending the disclosed content to the configured LLM endpoint or have set a local BASE_URL.
llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed skill-management tool with broad but mostly gated network and local-library actions.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: skillnet
Version: 2.0.3

The skillnet bundle provides a comprehensive framework for managing AI agent skills, including searching, downloading, and creating new skills. The bundle demonstrates a strong security posture by including explicit guardrails in SKILL.md and security-privacy.md that instruct the agent to treat all downloaded content as untrusted, require user confirmation for sensitive actions, and avoid executing third-party scripts automatically. The provided Python scripts (skillnet_create.py and skillnet_validate.py) are transparent wrappers for the skillnet-ai library and do not contain any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized credential usage. All network communication is directed to legitimate services such as GitHub or the user's specified LLM endpoint.
